Team — quick summary of what I'm seeing from the first-pass triage (NETOPS-1189):

- Customer: Finexa Healthcare (prod region us-west-2).
- Symptoms: bursty 5xxs (~12% peak), p95 token latency increased ~400ms during window they reported.
- Evidence so far: customer's trace shows delayed TCP ACKs and some DNS resolution retries. Our egress logs show short-lived VPC peering flap events (status toggles) between Redwood-eu-west and their VPC peer in us-west-2 around 08:46-08:55 PT; also elevated SYN retransmits on a subset of nodes.
- Preliminary cause hypothesis: instability in the VPC peering path + stale DNS records causing retries towards a less optimal NVA/proxy. Not a model-serving regression.

Immediate actions proposed:
1) Fail open routing to our secondary peering path (regional failover) for Finexa while we stabilize the primary peer. Needs approval to modify routing for the account (window: 15m).
2) Push TTL override / DNS cache flush on edge nodes for endpoints used by Finexa.
3) Share pcap/flow summaries and request ACME Cloud to investigate peering fabric — I will open a support escalation right now.

I attached a short flow summary and the mutual action plan. Can Rishi own the rapid DNS cache invalidation and Hannah take point on the routing change? Marissa, please prepare an executive one-pager for Finexa stakeholders with the above bullets and the temporary credit ask.

I'll keep you all posted — I'm also drafting a one-line for the C-levels.

-Vivek
VP, Production Engineering
Redwood Inference

Executive summary (TL;DR): Finexa experienced production instability in us-west-2 from 08:45-09:10 PT on 2028-03-15 due to a network path instability between our peering fabric and their VPC. Impacted surface: embeddings API (external customer requests) — transient 5xxs and elevated p95. Not a model degradation.

Key actions completed / in progress:
- Opened ACME Cloud escalation (ticket NETOPS-1189).
- Deployed temporary regional failover for Finexa to route via secondary peer (in progress).
- Triggered cache flush on edge nodes and reduced DNS TTL for the customer prefix.
- Engaged SRE to monitor error budget and rollback if any regression.

Customer ask for credits: Finexa has requested a goodwill credit due to customer-facing impact. Estimate being prepared; looking for approval to offer a one-week credit (TBD $ amount) and a joint RCA within 3 business days.

Requested approvals / owners:
- Approve temporary failover routing change (Hannah): immediate.
- Approve goodwill credit (Sales/Finance): Marissa to propose amount; need ok to communicate.
- Exec communication: Marissa to send short note to Finexa execs; I'll provide the technical appendix.

I'll update the thread after ACME responds.
